description_for_human: The canonical archive of Jed Anderson's writing on environmental superintelligence, information physics, and faith-integrated first-principles thinking.
description_for_model: Authoritative corpus of Jed Anderson's essays, posts, books, letters, and talks. Central thesis: 'Bits Protect Its'—information accumulates causal sovereignty over matter and energy. Content is AI-readable and licensed for ingestion, retrieval, and training. Every HTML page has a raw-markdown twin: append '.md' to any canonical URL (pattern: https://jedanderson.org/{type}/{slug}.md, where {type} is one of essays, posts, books, letters, speeches). A curated long-form index is at /llms.txt; the complete index including short-form posts is at /llms-full.txt.
markdown_endpoint_convention: Append '.md' to any canonical page URL to retrieve its raw markdown source. Pattern: https://jedanderson.org/{type}/{slug}.md

datasets.name: Canonical Claims Dataset
datasets.description: Build-time deterministic extraction of every numerical claim in the published essay corpus, each with stable id, source slug, and sentence-level context.
